digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and ticket save-time validation
propositions: The plan-review admission guard fast-fails descriptions exceeding the configured cap at review time; save-time warning must alert users immediately so they can edit before review attempt.
The description cap must read from a single config key (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) across all readers: the plan-review guard, completion precheck, and new save-time warning.

On create and edit operations across all surfaces (CLI, library, MCP), when description exceeds the cap and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning must be emitted at save time without blocking or altering the write.

The warning must be silent when the gate is disabled, the description is within the cap, or the ticket type is exempt; it must degrade gracefully (return None) on any unexpected error to preserve write safety.

The save-time warning must be surfaced through the appropriate channel per surface: CLI stderr (keeping stdout pure), rebar logger for library callers (edit_ticket return type widened to str | None), and MCP result field (description_warning on CreateResultOut and WriteAckOut).
